name: NGC 5806, host of SN 2004dg (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 5806, a spiral galaxy that hosted supernova SN 2004dg, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2004dg-hubble
story: Hubble returned to this spiral galaxy to pinpoint where the supernova SN 2004dg had exploded, comparing with images it had taken before the star blew up. At the galaxy's core, a supermassive black hole is pulling in large amounts of matter.

claims.text: It hosted SN 2004dg, which Hubble imaged to pinpoint its location
Hubble had pre-explosion images of the galaxy
It has an active nucleus with a supermassive black hole pulling in matter
